summary: WFC-003 is the SOLE author of the canonical workforce organization, active-manager, vendor-identity, and quarantine contract under CP-102. This handoff is the decision-complete input to WFC-004's schema authoring and to DB-012/ORG-007's vendor work. The canonical key is organizations.id. Manager validation is pinned to the real org_members and org_role_permissions tables. Vendor identity is an entity id owned by exactly one organization, never a name. 22 ambiguities are recorded as explicit quarantine outcomes rather than resolved, and the three most consequential are listed under open_questions below. WFC-003 created no tables and no migrations.

consumers.instruction: Author the schema from contract section 6's nine numbered requirements. Do not re-derive identity. Additive and manual under CP-051: no supabase db reset, no blanket replay, one migration at a time.

Establish vendor organization ownership by CONSUMING this contract. Do not define vendor identity, vendor-to-organization ownership, or manager authority. If something you need is not specified here, it is a handoff back to WFC-003, not a local decision.
First action on unblocking is to READ this contract, not to design vendor identity. ORG-007 may add to the identity contract only via a handoff back to WFC-003.
Use resolveWorkforceOrganizationKey, validateActiveManagerMembership, classifyVendorOwnership, and proveSameOrganization from types/vendor-identity-contract.ts. Do not re-derive.
The not_authorized state must not leak whether a quarantined record exists. Quarantine is a server-side outcome, not a UI state.

manager_validation.rule: A user is an active manager of an organization iff an org_members row exists for (org_id, user_id) and status = 'active'. Management authority additionally requires has_perm(uid, oid, 'workforce.manage').

A member row with status invited or revoked exists and grants nothing. org_members is validated to admit exactly ('invited','active','revoked').

vendor_identity.rule: A vendor is a company entity belonging to exactly one organization, identified by an entity id and never by a name. A vendor record whose identity is a name is quarantined, not resolved.

vendor_identity.adopted_not_re_derived: VEND-102 (lib/admin/vendor-identity.ts, 354 lines, 143-line test) already defines name normalization, the zod input schema, the 80/40 duplicate thresholds, seven weighted duplicate signals, and the merge plan. This contract adopts it.

open_questions_deliberately_unresolved: No vendor entity table exists anywhere in the migration chain. Only vendor_contracts, event_vendor_requests, and tour_vendors exist, and all three store a free-text vendor_name. Ownership is org-proven on two of them; identity is proven on none.

Six vendor tables are read by live routes but exist in NEITHER the migration chain NOR lib/database.types.ts: vendors (app/api/admin/vendors/route.ts:20), org_vendors, vendor_compliance_documents, org_contracts, contract_signature_envelopes (app/api/admin/organization/vendor-governance/route.ts:17,33,48,64), and vendor_aliases. A route reading one returns a PostgREST ERROR, not an empty result, so 'no vendors found' is not evidence of no vendors (CP-098). WFC-003 did NOT decide whether `vendors` and `org_vendors` are one entity or two; guessing they are the same is exactly the merge CP-096 forbids.

org_members has two revocation representations and only one is honored. Both status (20260821180438:76-78) and revoked_at (:57) exist, but NO migration ever sets revoked_at, so it is always null. Only status='revoked' revokes.

MANAGER_SCOPE_GAP: CP-094's department-scoped manager authority is not expressible in the current capability contract. AdminCapabilityTarget['type'] admits only organization|tour|event|site_map|document (lib/auth/admin-capabilities.ts:193-195), while DEPARTMENT_MANAGER_CAPABILITIES grants workforce.manage unqualified (:113-119, :129) and a scopeless grant is an organization grant (:253-259).

staff_members has NO tenant-scoped RLS: its only three policies are all auth.role() = 'authenticated' (20250818120000_admin_staffing_core.sql:362,396,427), so any authenticated user can read any org's org_id, email, phone, and hourly_rate. It also has no fail-closed scope CHECK, unlike staff_shifts which has a validated one (20260821031214:51-56), and its org_id is nullable on delete set null. Recorded, not changed.
staff_members_org_user_key is partial (20260821031214:86-88): it only constrains rows where org_id is not null, so the quarantined population is unconstrained and may duplicate freely.

No department table exists anywhere in the chain and every department column is free text (lib/database.types.ts:16476, 4556, 3735, 9144, 12431, 15913, 16727). CP-094 already rejected free-text department fields as a responsibility boundary.
Two VendorCategory vocabularies coexist and are not reconcilable by inference: eight values in lib/admin/vendor-identity.ts:8-17 versus sixteen in lib/admin/vendor-domain.ts:23-26.
The full 22-row ambiguity table is in the contract document section 5, each row with evidence and an owning lane.
